name: zdtime
description: time step length (overwritten in main_SEB_firn.py from the forcing frequency)

name: dev
description: time step interpolation factor 1 to n (to keep sub-surface calculations stable)

name: dTsurf_ini
description: initial surface temperature step in the search for EB=0

name: dz_ice
description: distance between vertical sub-surface levels

name: z_max
description: maximum depth of the sub-surface column

name: EB_max
description: surface temperature iteration stops when the energy budget imbalance is below EB_max

name: iter_max_EB
description: maximum number of iterations to reach EB=0

name: iter_max_flux
description: maximum number of iterations in the flux-profile calculation

name: L_dif
description: convergence limit on the change in Obukhov length during flux iterations

name: prec_cutoff
description: elevation below which precipitation is halved

name: prec_rate
description: artificial precipitation rate

name: RH_min
description: lowest possible relative humidity over snow and ice after extrapolation over the DEM

name: WS_lim
description: wind speed below which turbulent fluxes are set to zero to prevent model instability

name: year
description: choice of year

name: precip_rate
description: precipitation rate

name: fresh_snow_dens
description: density of fresh snow

name: Tdeep
description: deep firn temperature at the bottom boundary (overwritten in main_SEB_firn.py)

name: verbose
description: 1 = print progress and make diagnostic plots; 0 = silent

name: avoid_runoff
description: if 1 runoff is not allowed

name: sw_penetration
description: enable shortwave penetration into subsurface layers (1 = on; 0 = off)

name: THF_calc
description: choice of turbulent heat flux calculation: 1 = bulk; 2 = profile if possible; 3 = calculate both and save both results

name: lim_new_lay
description: thickness of the snow bucket above which a new layer is created

name: snowthick_ini
description: initial snow thickness

name: output_path
description: folder where model output is written

name: station_info
description: path to the station information file

name: initial_state_folder_path
description: folder containing the initial density/temperature/grain size profiles
